![What is Agile project management? Definition, methods, types ...](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/10081734-2633-0066-0000-54bff10e0251:4)
Agile project management is `a flexible, iterative approach that breaks work into short cycles called sprints to prioritize adaptability, collaboration, and continuous delivery over rigid planning`.[[1]](https://instituteprojectmanagement.com/blog/agile-methodology/)[[2]](https://www.cio.com/article/237027/agile-project-management-a-beginners-guide.html)

### Core Values (The Agile Manifesto)

- **Individuals and interactions** over processes and tools.
- **Working products** over comprehensive documentation.
- **Customer collaboration** over contract negotiation.
- **Responding to change** over following a strict plan.[[1]](https://www.apm.org.uk/resources/find-a-resource/agile-project-management/)[[2]](https://instituteprojectmanagement.com/blog/agile-methodology/)

### How It Works: Phases and Cycles

Agile replaces long, linear phases (like traditional Waterfall) with short, repeatable cycles (typically 1 to 4 weeks long):[[1]](https://www.cio.com/article/237027/agile-project-management-a-beginners-guide.html)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/v7ivGkOJ7HM)

1. **Initiation & Planning:** Define high-level goals and build a prioritized list of tasks, known as the **backlog**.
2. **Execution (Sprints):** Teams work in short bursts to build, test, and complete a small functional piece of the project.
3. **Review:** Stakeholders and team members review the completed work and share feedback.
4. **Retrospective:** The team looks back at the cycle to discuss what went well, what failed, and how to improve next time.[[1]](https://www.atlassian.com/agile/project-management)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YjVHZ5mzKJI&t=4)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ihhNWV9vHX0)[[4]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/v7ivGkOJ7HM)

### Popular Frameworks

- **Scrum:** Uses fixed-length sprints, defined team roles, and regular meetings (ceremonies) like daily stand-ups.
- **Kanban:** Relies on visual boards with limits on work-in-progress to manage a continuous flow of tasks.
- **Lean:** Focuses on cutting waste and maximizing efficient value delivery.[[1]](https://www.coursera.org/articles/agile-project-management)[[2]](https://www.atlassian.com/agile/project-management)[[3]](https://instituteprojectmanagement.com/blog/agile-methodology/)

### Key Benefits

- **High Flexibility:** Easy to pivot and adapt when requirements change or new feedback arrives.
- **Early Value Delivery:** Shipped functional pieces mean users get benefits early rather than waiting until the very end of a project.
- **Stronger Engagement:** Frequent customer and stakeholder collaboration ensures the final result matches real needs.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ihhNWV9vHX0)[[2]](https://www.cio.com/article/237027/agile-project-management-a-beginners-guide.html)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OTiX7EQ0xBI&t=49)

For a deeper dive into starting your career or formal training in these methods, visit [Coursera's Agile Guide](https://www.coursera.org/articles/agile-project-management) or read the [Institute of Project Management](https://instituteprojectmanagement.com/blog/agile-methodology/) overview.[[1]](https://instituteprojectmanagement.com/blog/agile-methodology/)[[2]](https://www.coursera.org/articles/agile-project-management)
